messages:
erin: FYI — finance customer asking for BYOK where the HSM stays in their VPC. Requirements: our runtime must be able to trigger emergency rotations/failovers but must never see plaintext key material. Need RBAC change, audit-log plan, KMS-proxy integration. Who owns the design?

mike_oncall: Can you enumerate the exact ops we need (wrap/unwrap/rotate/revoke/export)? SLO for emergency rotation?

erin: Ops list: wrap/unwrap via our proxy, rotate wrapped-blob, emergency-rekey (service triggers rewrap against customer's HSM), failover to hosted model variant if proxy unreachable. Rotation SLO: 15m for emergency path.

jordan_sec: Proposed model: service stores only wrapped key blobs. No plaintext anywhere in our control plane. Create a dedicated service role 'key_proxy' allowed to call Unwrap/Wrap via the proxy only. Humans get a separate 'ops_rotation' role that can trigger rewraps but cannot call unwrap directly. Example policy snippet: ```json
{
  "Role": "key_proxy",
  "Actions": ["kms:WrapKey", "kms:UnwrapKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:alias/redwood-key-proxy",
  "Condition": {
    "Bool": {"kms:ViaProxy": "true"}
  }
}
```

mike_oncall: How do we ensure humans can't call the proxy directly? Need network ACLs + mTLS + attestation checks on the HSM side. Also capture session evidence for every rotation.

jordan_sec: Enforce mTLS client certs for the proxy front-end, validate HSM attestation before accepting unwraps. Use short-lived wrapping keys derived from attestation. All Unwrap events go to tenant-secure log bucket with integrity metadata, and to SIEM. Example Splunk filter to spot unexpected unwraps: ```splunk
index=keys action=unwrap tenant=acme | stats count by user, src_ip, method
```

clara_legal: Compliance note: finance customers require 7 years retention for key access logs, WORM storage for audit trail, and documented business justification for every human-approved rotation. We'll prepare standard contract language.

sre_tess: Heads up: we have a vuln in hsm-proxy v1.2.1 flagged by sec-bot. Mitigation plan: pin to patched v1.2.3, rotate wrapping-key epochs, revoke TLS certs issued in last 30d, deploy canary to staging, run rewrap/unwrap tests. Oncall checklist: 1) patch 2) rotate 3) verify unwrap logs 4) enable heightened alerting.

sec-bot: New alert created: HSM-PROXY CVE-2026-0456; severity=MEDIUM; link=https://sec.redwood/alerts/5261.

mike_oncall: For incidents: automatic rollback -> if proxy healthcheck fails 5x within 2m, route inference traffic to hosted fallback variant with masked outputs, create incident channel, and escalate to legal if PII could be exposed. Also publish incident timeline to tenant's audit bucket.

erin: Can we keep RBAC delta minimal? Ideally add 'key_proxy' service role + 'ops_rotation' human role and update runbook. I'll open an RFC today; need engineering review before EOD Friday.

jordan_sec: I'll draft the RBAC policy + IAM conditions for 'no-human-key-export' and post it in #eng-security RFC thread.

clara_legal: I'll draft the retention/attestation clause and run it by compliance & product.

sre_tess: I'll schedule the patch + canary window and add SIEM alert thresholds (unusual unwrap frequency, high source diversity).

erin: Action items: @jordan_sec draft RBAC policy, @sre_tess patch + canary, @clara_legal retention clause, @mike_oncall update oncall runbook by Thu. Quick test command for reviewers: ```bash
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood/v1/unwrap -H 'Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>' -d '{"wrapped_blob":"<base64>"}'
```

mike_oncall: One more — we should add an auditable human-approval step for emergency rotations where a signed ticket is required before ops can hit the rotation API. That ticket ID must be in the unwrap log entry.

erin: Agree. Put ticket ID into correlation_id field for both logs and SIEM events. Thanks all :thumbsup:
